add-lemon-to-fish.instruction: Take the lemon wedge from the fridge and place it on the plate with fish on the dining counter.

assemble-cooking-array.instruction: Move the shrimp onto the pan on the stove. Then move the syrup bottle and broccoli from the cabinet to the counter where the plate is.

beverage-sorting.instruction: Sort all alcoholic drinks to one cabinet, and non-alcoholic drinks to the other.

bread-and-cheese.instruction: Place the bread and cheese on the cutting board.

candle-cleanup.instruction: Pick the candle and jar from the dining table and place them in the open cabinet. Close the cabinet after placing the objects.

cereal-and-bowl.instruction: Open the cabinet. Pick the cereal and bowl from the cabinet and place them on the counter next to the milk. Then close the cabinet.

choose-measuring-cup.instruction: Open the right drawer and place the smaller measuring cup on the counter.

clear-food-waste.instruction: Move the food items out of the sink and into the colander.

clear-sink.instruction: Remove the corn and carrot from the sink. Then move the bowl and cup from the counter to the sink for washing.

cookie-dough-prep.instruction: Pick the egg and butter from the fridge and place them by the bowl for mixing.

deliver-brewed-coffee.instruction: Pick up the brewed coffee from the coffee machine and place it next to the breakfast plate on the dining counter.

dessert-upgrade.instruction: Move the dessert items from the plates to the tray.

display-meat-variety.instruction: Retrieve the chicken drumstick, shrimp, and steak from the fridge and place them on the serving tray on the dining counter.

divide-basins.instruction: Move any existing items from the left basin to the right basin for drying. Then move the cup from the counter to the left basin of the sink for washing.

drain-veggies.instruction: Dump the lettuce from the pot into the sink. Then turn on the water and wash the lettuce. Then turn off the water and put the lettuce back in the pot.

drinkware-consolidation.instruction: Pick the bottled water from the counter and place it in the open cabinet.

make-ice-lemonade.instruction: Grab a lemon wedge from the fridge and one ice cube from the ice bowl, and put them in the glass of lemonade.

make-loaded-potato.instruction: Retrieve the reheated potato from the microwave, then place the potato, cheese, and condiment on the cutting board.

meal-prep-staging.instruction: Place both pans onto different burners. Then place the corn and the steak on different pans.

microwave-defrost-meat.instruction: Place the tupperware containing the frozen chicken drumstick in the microwave. Close the microwave door and press the start button to defrost the meat.

organize-coffee-condiments.instruction: Pick the syrup bottle and honey bottle from the cabinet and place them next to the mug.

organize-mugs-by-handle.instruction: Pick the mug on the counter and place it in the cabinet with the handle facing the right, like the mugs already inside.

oven-broil-fish.instruction: Place the fish on the bottom rack of the oven, and slide the tray back inside. Close the oven door.

pack-dessert.instruction: Add the marshmallow to the tupperware that contains the hot dog.

pick-place-cabinet-to-counter.instruction: Pick the ice cube from the cabinet and place it on the counter.

pick-place-sink-to-counter.instruction: Pick the egg from the sink and place it on the plate located on the counter.

plate-steak-meal.instruction: Create a steak meal by picking up the steak and asparagus from the tray and placing them on the plate. Leave the chili pepper on the tray.

portion-in-tupperware.instruction: Place one cooked food and one vegetable from the large plate to each tupperware container.

pre-rinse-station.instruction: Place the glass cup in the left basin and the kettle in the right basin of the sink.

prep-for-sanitizing.instruction: Pick the bar soap and dish brush from the cabinet and place them on the counter.

prep-marinating-meat.instruction: Pick the shrimp from the plate and place it on the cutting board. Then pick the condiment bottle from the cabinet and place it next to the cutting board.

reheat-meal.instruction: Place the tupperware containing the shrimp and carrot meal in the microwave. Close the microwave door and press the start button to reheat the meal.

retrieve-meat.instruction: Retrieve the fish from the fridge and place it on the cutting board.

sanitize-prep-cutting-board.instruction: Grab the spray bottle from the cabinet, then place it next to the cutting board for sanitizing. Then grab the dish brush from the countertop next to the sink and place it next to the cutting board.

scrub-bowl.instruction: Use the sponge to scrub the bowl inside the sink.

searing-meat.instruction: Grab the pan from the cabinet and place it on the rear right burner on the stove. Then place the chicken drumstick on the stove and turn the burner on.

seasoning-spice-setup.instruction: Move the condiment bottle and ketchup from the cabinet to the dining counter.

set-up-cutting-station.instruction: Pick up the knife from the drawer and place it on the cutting board. Then place the meat from the plate to the cutting board.

stocking-breakfast-foods.instruction: Pick the canned food and bar from the counter and place them in the cabinets closest to them.

sweeten-coffee.instruction: Take a sugar cube from the saucer and place it inside the coffee. Then, grab milk from the fridge and place it next to the coffee on the counter to sweeten the coffee.

thaw-in-sink.instruction: Pick the orange from the counter and place it in the sink. Then turn on the sink faucet.

tong-buffet-setup.instruction: Take the tongs from the drawer on the left and place them on the dining counter next to the tray containing the hot dog.

turn-off-microwave.instruction: Press the stop button on the microwave.

turn-on-microwave.instruction: Press the start button on the microwave.

turn-on-stove.instruction: Turn on the rear left burner of the stove.

turn-on-toaster-oven.instruction: Turn on the toaster oven by setting the timer.
